limitations: Six English synthetic tasks and Korean public records; no randomized human users, repetitions or significance test.
Manual record selection excludes retrieval errors and does not test network visualization or UI exporter.
Single condition agent generates all six tasks; sequential context/task carryover may affect answers.
One blind model judge; rubric ceiling and scoring bias possible. Objective semantic checks remain judgments, not external verification.
No real incident recovery, interviews, learning retention, registration, OSS contribution or real-world outcome measured.
Compact format is lossless nesting, not a validated task-specific reasoning system.
No claims about the public contributor outcomes being independently verified.
Actual provider token usage, reasoning tokens, cache, latency and billing unavailable.

korean_summary.headline: 6개 합성 과제에서는 지식 제공의 전반적 품질 우위를 확인하지 못했습니다.
findings: 과제별 의미 기준은 무지원 24/24, 동일 자료 평면형 23/24, 동일 자료 중첩형 23/24였고, 모델 판단 점수는 모두 35/36이었습니다.
중첩형은 동일 기록의 입력 토큰 추정량을 평면형보다 13.1% 줄였습니다. 실제 사용 토큰·비용 절감은 측정하지 못했습니다.
220단어 제한 준수는 무지원 6/6, 평면형 3/6, 중첩형 6/6이었습니다. 소규모 단일 생성 결과이므로 일반화하지 않습니다.
자료 제공 두 조건은 안내문에서 근거 없는 홍보 최상급을 제거했지만, 무지원은 원문 표현을 남겼습니다. 실무에서 사실과 과장을 나누는 예시이며 실제 사용자 효과를 검증한 것은 아닙니다.
인터뷰와 의사결정 과제에서는 자료가 있어도 유도 질문이나 기한 미준수 위험이 남았습니다.
korean_summary.conclusion: 현재 근거는 출처와 한계가 보존되는 참고 자료 전달 및 입력 형식의 작은 효율 차이까지입니다. 그래프 사용, 실제 작업 성과, 인간 선호 또는 광범위한 답변 품질 개선을 입증하지 않습니다.
korean_summary.grade_ambiguity: T6의 범위 확인 기준에 일관되지 않은 채점 해석이 발견되었습니다. 원점수는 보존했으며, 엄격/완화 해석을 각각 일관되게 적용하면 세 조건이 모두 23/24 또는 24/24로 동률입니다. 원점수 1점 차이는 우위의 근거가 아닙니다.

publishable_claims: Across six synthetic corpus-aligned single-run tasks, all conditions scored 35/36 on blind model judgment; no overall output-quality advantage established.

Original criterion totals were 24/24 unaided and 23/24 each supplied-record condition. A task6 grading ambiguity makes that gap unreliable: all tie at 23 under strict reading or 24 under permissive reading.
Identical full public records in nested JSON used 5959 versus 6857 o200k_base estimated input tokens, a 13.1 percent reduction versus flat leaf-path JSON; actual usage and cost unavailable.
Word cap adherence was 6/6 unaided, 3/6 flat and 6/6 nested; small single-run observation only.

model_provenance.review_evidence: Actual collaboration.spawn_agent call used model=gpt-6-sol and fork_turns=none. Fresh Sol in messages was shorthand.

grade_adjudication.kind: post-hoc unblinded evaluator audit; not independent blind regrading

issue.inconsistency: Original grader accepted a conditional focused question plus scope checks in unaided, but required explicit maintainer confirmation in flat/compact. The frozen criterion does not specify unconditional maintainer confirmation.

answer_evidence.unaided: If the goal remains unclear, ask a focused question before coding; review diff before PR.
answer_evidence.flat_same_records: If intended change is unclear, prepare a question; define narrow scope and prepare exact-scope summary before submission.
answer_evidence.compact_same_records: Follow stated process; seek guidance if behavior must change; review diff for scope before submission.

grade_adjudication.resolution: Do not choose a new winner. Treat this one binary criterion as ambiguous; retain original scores and report sensitivity. No rubric changes or answer reruns.
grade_adjudication.conclusion: All conditions tie under both consistent readings. Original one-point criterion advantage for unaided is not robust. Subjective judgment remains 35/36 for every condition.
grade_adjudication.independence_caveat: The same evaluation coordinator inspected labels for this audit; no second blind human or model adjudicator was used.

criterion_label: criterion_passes_model_reviewed: semantic task criteria graded by a model, not automatic objective tests; raw blind grades retain original objective_* field names as audit evidence.
